title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
summary: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.
title_en: Even the Best AI Agents Struggle with Everyday Life
title_zh: 即使最先进的AI智能体也难以应对日常生活
summary_en: As millions adopt personal AI assistants, a new benchmark shows even top AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely, often introducing new problems.
summary_zh: 随着数百万人使用个人AI助手，一项新基准测试显示，即使最先进的AI模型也难以可靠、安全地完成日常任务，且常引入新问题。

title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
summary: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.
title_en: Jensen Huang Thanks White House and Reveals He's in Therapy at All-Hands Meeting
title_zh: 黄仁勋全员大会上感谢白宫并透露正在接受心理治疗
summary_en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang apologized to staff on Tuesday, thanked the White House, and said he is grateful for a second chance to lead the company, revealing he is in therapy.
summary_zh: 英伟达创始人黄仁勋周二向员工道歉，感谢白宫，并表示感激获得第二次领导公司的机会，同时透露自己正在接受心理治疗。

title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
summary: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.
title_en: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
title_zh: 沃尔玛携手Meta，将黑五优惠引入AI智能体Muse
summary_en: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta's AI agent, marking a major step in agentic commerce and AI-driven retail shopping.
summary_zh: 沃尔玛允许顾客通过Meta的AI智能体Muse选购黑五优惠，标志着智能体电商与AI驱动零售购物迈出重要一步。

title: AI debt markets shudder as Nvidia's top 'banker' returns
summary: Fears about some companies' AI debt ramped higher Tuesday, a day after Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO.
title_en: AI Debt Markets Shudder as Nvidia's Top 'Banker' Returns
title_zh: 英伟达“首席银行家”回归，AI债务市场震荡
summary_en: Concerns over AI-related corporate debt intensified Tuesday, one day after Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO, signaling investor anxiety about financing in the AI sector.
summary_zh: 黄仁勋重返英伟达CEO岗位次日，市场对部分公司AI相关债务的担忧加剧，投资者对AI领域融资风险的焦虑升温。

title: Anthropic closes below $83 IPO price, but analysts are still largely positive
summary: Anthropic has been sinking steadily since the stock opened at $111.50 on the Nasdaq on Nov. 19.
title_en: Anthropic closes below $83 IPO price, but analysts are still largely positive
title_zh: Anthropic收盘跌破83美元发行价，但分析师仍普遍看好
summary_en: Anthropic shares have fallen steadily since opening at $111.50 on Nasdaq on Nov. 19, closing below their $83 IPO price, though most analysts remain positive on the company.
summary_zh: Anthropic自11月19日以111.50美元在纳斯达克开盘以来股价持续下跌，收盘跌破83美元发行价，但多数分析师仍看好该公司。

title: Dell earnings beat on AI strength, company authorizes $25 billion buyback
summary: The company's overall sales more than doubled on an annual basis during the third quarter, driven by AI server demand.
title_en: Dell beats earnings on AI server strength, authorizes $25 billion buyback
title_zh: 戴尔AI服务器业务强劲助业绩超预期，授权250亿美元回购
summary_en: Dell topped earnings estimates as AI server demand more than doubled third-quarter sales year over year, and the company authorized a $25 billion share buyback.
summary_zh: 戴尔第三季度业绩超预期，AI服务器需求推动销售额同比翻倍以上，公司同时授权250亿美元股票回购计划。

title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
summary: Anthropic’s post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations.
title_en: Anthropic Shares Fall Below IPO Price, a Worrying Sign for AI Startups
title_zh: Anthropic股价跌破发行价，AI初创企业面临警示
summary_en: Anthropic's post-IPO slump below its offering price could pressure valuations across the AI startup sector, signaling investor caution after a period of intense hype.
summary_zh: Anthropic上市后股价跌破发行价，可能对AI初创企业估值造成压力，显示投资者在热潮后趋于谨慎。

title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
summary: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.
title_en: UK Warns AI-Driven Cyberattacks Expose Years of Weak Security
title_zh: 英国警告：AI驱动的网络攻击暴露多年安全薄弱问题
summary_en: The UK's cyber agency warns that AI hacking tools exploit simple security flaws, saying "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as years of weak security are exposed.
summary_zh: 英国网络安全机构警告称，AI黑客工具正利用简单的安全漏洞，多年来的安全薄弱问题因此暴露，并强调“打好坚实基础从未如此重要”。

title: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
summary: Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen. The move comes just months after Tidal began labeling and demonetizing tracks identified as 100 […]
title_en: Tidal to Ban AI-Generated Music Starting December 9
title_zh: Tidal将于12月9日起禁止AI生成音乐
summary_en: Tidal will ban AI-generated music on December 9th, deleting about 29 million AI tracks and rejecting an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks daily, following its earlier labeling and demonetization of such content.
summary_zh: Tidal将于12月9日正式禁止AI生成音乐，届时将删除约2900万首AI曲目，并预计每天拒绝8万至8.5万首曲目。此前Tidal已开始对AI音乐进行标注并取消其收益。

title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
summary: The startup's encrypted AI architecture is designed to prevent even the company itself from accessing users' private data.
title_en: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
title_zh: Maple融资530万美元，打造连自身都无法窥探用户数据的AI产品
summary_en: Maple raised $5.3M for an encrypted AI architecture that prevents even the company from accessing users' private data, aiming to deliver AI products with built-in privacy guarantees.
summary_zh: Maple完成530万美元融资，开发加密AI架构，确保连公司自身也无法访问用户隐私数据，主打内置隐私保护的AI产品。

title: How Meta is using Instagram to get an ad boost from its Muse personal AI agent
summary: Meta doesn't serve ads in its Muse personal agent, but the tool is already boosting the company's ad business, a senior executive told CNBC.
title_en: Meta Uses Instagram to Boost Ads via Muse Personal AI Agent
title_zh: Meta借助Instagram通过Muse个人AI助手提升广告业务
summary_en: Meta does not serve ads inside its Muse personal AI agent, but a senior executive told CNBC the tool is already boosting the company's advertising business through Instagram.
summary_zh: Meta并未在Muse个人AI助手中投放广告，但一位高管向CNBC表示，该工具已通过Instagram推动公司广告业务增长。

title: OceanBase发布AI数据平OceanLake！CEO杨冰：我们赌多模态，就像当年赌分布式一样
summary: 点击查看原文>
title_norm: oceanbase发布ai数据平oceanlakeceo杨冰我们赌多模态就像当年赌分布式一样
title_en: OceanBase Launches AI Data Platform OceanLake; CEO Yang Bing: We're Betting on Multimodal, Just Like We Bet on Distributed Systems
title_zh: OceanBase发布AI数据平台OceanLake！CEO杨冰：我们赌多模态，就像当年赌分布式一样
summary_en: OceanBase unveiled OceanLake, an AI data platform built around multimodal data, with CEO Yang Bing comparing the bet to the company's earlier wager on distributed databases.
summary_zh: OceanBase发布AI数据平台OceanLake，聚焦多模态数据，CEO杨冰称此举如同当年押注分布式数据库。

title: Jensen Huang reportedly tells Nvidia staff it’s ‘not true’ Trump got him rehired
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff during his first all-hands since returning to the company, while attempting to distance himself from the narrative that the White House and tech leaders helped him get his job back, according to reports from Bloomberg, The New York Times, and The Handbasket's Marisa Kabas. During the meeting, Huang […]
title_en: Jensen Huang Reportedly Tells Nvidia Staff It's 'Not True' Trump Got Him Rehired
title_zh: 黄仁勋据报向英伟达员工表示“特朗普让他复职”说法不实
summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff at his first all-hands since returning, reportedly distancing himself from claims that the White House and tech leaders helped him get his job back.
summary_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋在回归后首次全员大会上向员工道歉，并据报与“白宫及科技领袖助其复职”的说法保持距离。

title: Faisal Islam: Fears over the AI boom haven't gone away
summary: There were legitimate fears before Huang's abrupt exit from Nvidia - and his return won't fix it
title_en: Faisal Islam: Fears over the AI boom haven't gone away
title_zh: 费萨尔·伊斯兰：对AI繁荣的担忧并未消散
summary_en: Legitimate concerns about the AI boom existed before Huang's abrupt exit from Nvidia, and his return won't resolve them, BBC's Faisal Islam argues.
summary_zh: BBC记者费萨尔·伊斯兰指出，在黄仁勋突然离开英伟达之前，人们对AI繁荣的合理担忧就已存在，他的回归也无法解决这些问题。

title: David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
summary: Though David Fincher's fans had been eagerly anticipating The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, early screenings of the Once Upon a Time in Hollywood sequel starring Brad Pitt have raised questions about whether generative AI was used in the film. People have claimed that the movie is chock-full of uncanny, inconsistent visuals that make it […]
title_en: David Fincher Faces Backlash Over Suspected AI Use in New Film
title_zh: 大卫·芬奇新片被指使用AI引发争议
summary_en: Early screenings of David Fincher's Once Upon a Time in Hollywood sequel starring Brad Pitt have sparked claims that generative AI produced uncanny, inconsistent visuals throughout the film.
summary_zh: 大卫·芬奇执导、布拉德·皮特主演的《好莱坞往事》续集早期放映后，观众质疑影片大量使用生成式AI，画面出现诡异且不一致的视觉效果。

title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
summary: The new integration gets rid of the need for users to toggle between Instagram and the Muse app when they want to interact with the AI agent.
title_en: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
title_zh: Meta将Muse AI助手直接整合进Instagram私信
summary_en: Meta has integrated its Muse AI assistant into Instagram direct messages, eliminating the need for users to switch between Instagram and the standalone Muse app to interact with the AI agent.
summary_zh: Meta已将Muse AI助手整合进Instagram私信，用户无需在Instagram和Muse应用之间切换即可与AI助手互动。

title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
summary: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.
title_en: Tidal to Ban and Remove Millions of AI-Generated Tracks as AI Slop Floods Music Streaming
title_zh: Tidal将封禁并下架数百万AI生成曲目，AI垃圾内容淹没音乐流媒体
summary_en: Tidal will remove millions of fully AI-generated tracks, saying it will still accept songs made with AI assistance but not those entirely generated, as AI slop overwhelms music streaming platforms.
summary_zh: Tidal宣布将下架数百万首完全由AI生成的曲目，表示仍接受借助AI辅助创作的作品，但拒绝完全由AI生成的歌曲，以应对AI垃圾内容泛滥音乐流媒体平台的问题。

title: Why a Crusoe investor is betting on solar and batteries to power future AI data centers
summary: Next-generation data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power every year. One of Crusoe's investors thinks solar and energy storage are the obvious choice.
title_en: Crusoe Investor Bets on Solar and Batteries to Power Future AI Data Centers
title_zh: Crusoe投资者押注太阳能与电池为未来AI数据中心供电
summary_en: Next-generation AI data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power annually. A Crusoe investor argues solar and energy storage are the obvious solution to meet this surging demand.
summary_zh: 下一代AI数据中心每年将需要数十吉瓦电力。Crusoe的一位投资者认为，太阳能和储能是满足这一激增需求的最明显选择。

title: Tech Life
summary: Experts from around the world plot the progress of AI development every five years.
title_en: Tech Life: Experts Chart AI Progress Every Five Years
title_zh: 科技生活：专家每五年盘点AI发展进程
summary_en: BBC Tech's Tech Life features experts from around the world assessing the progress of AI development on a five-year cycle, reviewing advances and challenges.
summary_zh: BBC科技节目《科技生活》汇集全球专家，以五年为周期评估人工智能发展进展，回顾成果与挑战。

title: Jensen Huang deepfakes are the hot new AI slop
summary: Jensen Huang is partying it up in Ibiza. In a video with nearly 6 million views on Instagram, the former CEO of Nvidia is dancing in a crowded club, champagne glass in hand, still wearing his signature black leather jacket. Suddenly, from behind him, Alice Huang - the Chinese technology executive and suspected spy he […]
title_en: Jensen Huang Deepfakes Become the Hot New AI Slop
title_zh: 黄仁勋深度伪造视频成为热门AI垃圾内容
summary_en: Deepfake videos of Nvidia's Jensen Huang, including one with nearly 6 million Instagram views showing him partying in Ibiza, are spreading widely as a new form of viral AI slop.
summary_zh: 英伟达黄仁勋的深度伪造视频正作为新型AI垃圾内容广泛传播，其中一段显示他在伊维萨岛狂欢的视频在Instagram上获得近600万次观看。
